title: Phrases
subtitle: A2 · Unit 2: What happened this week?

steps.title: Phrases
steps.body: Say what happened first, then add a reason or result. Keep each sentence short enough to say comfortably.

steps.title: Say the whole block
steps.body: Learn these as blocks, exactly as you hear them. Say each one out loud. Tap the speaker to hear it.

steps.fr: Hier matin, j'ai terminé mon devoir avant le cours.
steps.en: Yesterday morning, I finished my assignment before class.
steps.tip: Say it: yehr mah-TA(N) zhay tehr-mee-NAY moh(n) duh-VWAHR ah-vah(n) luh koor

steps.fr: La semaine dernière, j'ai réservé une visite guidée.
steps.en: Last week, I booked a guided tour.
steps.tip: Say it: lah suh-MEN dehr-NYEHR zhay ray-zehr-VAY ün vee-ZEET gee-DAY

steps.fr: J'ai travaillé pendant une heure, puis j'ai trouvé un avis.
steps.en: I worked for an hour, then I found a notice.
steps.tip: Say it: zhay trah-vah-YAY pah(n)-DAH(N) ün uhr püi zhay troo-VAY uh(n) ah-VEE
Say it: lah lee-vray-ZOH(N) ah shahn-ZHAY duhr

steps.fr: J'ai réclamé un remboursement parce que le problème a retardé la livraison.
steps.en: I requested a refund because the problem delayed the delivery.
steps.tip: Say it: zhay ray-klah-MAY uh(n) rah(n)-boors-MAH(N) parsk luh proh-BLEHM ah ruh-tahr-DAY lah lee-vray-ZOH(N)

steps.fr: Heureusement, le service a réglé le problème le lendemain.
steps.en: Fortunately, the service resolved the problem the next day.
steps.tip: Say it: uh-ruh-ZMÄ(N) luh sehr-VEES ah ray-GLAY luh proh-BLEHM luh lah(n)-duh-MA(N)

steps.fr: J'ai emprunté un livre et j'ai terminé un chapitre vendredi.
steps.en: I borrowed a book and finished a chapter on Friday.
steps.tip: Say it: zhay ah(n)-pruh(n)-TAY uh(n) leevr eh zhay tehr-mee-NAY uh(n) shah-PEETR vahn-druh-DEE

steps.fr: Finalement, j'ai terminé mon travail et j'ai envoyé le courriel.
steps.en: In the end, I finished my work and sent the email.
steps.tip: Say it: fee-nahl-MAH(N) zhay tehr-mee-NAY moh(n) trah-VAHY eh zhay ah(n)-vwah-YAY luh koo-RYEL
